Definition: , or neuter πλεῖον, or πλέον comparative of G4183; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion:--X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.
BiblicalUsage: Pleion means more — greater in number, in measure, in worth. Jesus says a greater than Jonah is here in Matthew 12:41, and the widow cast in more than all in Mark 12:43. Many more believed because of His own word in John 4:41.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus is always the more — greater than Jonah, and the widow's two mites worth more than all the rest.
